entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to start a return for my VeloBand GPS Tracker. My order number is VF88-21-TANGO.
Certainly, I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order number.
Okay, I have your order right here. So I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the tracker? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
No fault, it works fine. I honestly just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy and I know I'm not going to use it.
I understand. Thank you for the honesty. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. One moment please.

Alright, I see here the band was delivered to you seven days ago. According to our policy, you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window, so we can definitely get that processed for a full refund.
Oh, great. That's simple. I was seeing some conflicting information online and thought I might have to deal with a resale marketplace or something.

Nope, you're all set for a direct return. I see you're a VIP member with us, so I've gone ahead and emailed you a prepaid shipping label. Just box it up, attach the label, and drop it off. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it.
Perfect. That's all I needed. Thanks, David.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
